scanner_evidence.message: A CSRF middleware was not detected in your express application. Ensure you are either using one such as `csurf` or `csrf` (see rule references) and/or you are properly doing CSRF validation in your routes with a token or cookies.

findings.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection')

scanner_evidence.message: User-controlled Express query input reaches a SQLite query execution function. Use parameterized SQL instead of constructing SQL with untrusted input.
